EC1: - The patient is in an exclusion period determined by a previous study
EC2: - The patient is under guardianship, [OR] under guardianship, [OR] or under the protection of justice
EC3: - The patient has already participated in this study
EC4: - The patient or his / her representative refuses to participate in the study
EC5: - The patient is pregnant, [OR] parturient or is breastfeeding
EC7: - The patient is in therapeutic limitation [OR] or moribund
EC8: - The patient has undergone [OR] or is going to have scheduled [OR] or emergency digestive surgery
EC10: - The patient has Child C cirrhosis
EC11: - The patient has progressive digestive neoplasia, [OR] digestive lymphoma, chronic inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease ...).
